title: French-Style Fennel Dumplings
description: A hearty French-inspired dish featuring fennel and homemade dumplings. Perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt. Gradually add warm water, mixing until a dough forms.
2. Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
3. Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a thin circle.
4. Heat 2 tbsp of zesty butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 4 dumplings and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
6. In a separate saucepan, melt 2 tbsp of zesty butter over medium heat. Add sliced fennel and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
7. Stir in ukrainian sour cream and chopped parsley. Season with black pepper to taste.
8. Serve the fennel sauce over the cooked dumplings.
